rules: canary workflow lives in owning repository but generated artifacts in workspace-control are inert staging material
workflow has no inputs and no candidate checkout
workflow invokes only the immutable root-installed v3 canary probe with a compile-time runner class constant
controller policy trusts only the exact canary workflow blob on the owning repository default branch
controller policy allows only workflow_dispatch by the exact owner actor
migration-only canary policy replaces ordinary production trusted workflows rather than adding authority
research GPU-derived classes remain blocked by inherited containment until separately authorized
offline model classes use a separate root-owned private-network payload broker; the migration canary proves online-runner/broker separation without consuming the broker or executing model inference

offline_payload_proof: online Actions runner has no GPU device grant and empty CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
online Actions runner cannot access exact promoted model/runtime objects
online Actions runner retains only GitHub control-plane-compatible networking
root-owned one-shot payload broker is active in a private network namespace with deny-all IP policy and loopback-only allow
payload broker alone has exact GPU devices plus exact promoted model/runtime read authority
runner and broker CPU/memory/task ceilings partition rather than duplicate the root-granted class envelope
migration canary inspects runner and broker cgroups/systemd properties without connecting to the broker socket or executing candidate/scientific payload
